summary: All critical and warning findings for the consent-first agent-history import were fixed and verified.

findings.description: Resumed imports trusted API-supplied discovery and source paths without matching the owner-only local manifest, allowing a write-capable API caller to turn the CLI into an arbitrary local JSONL reader.

Consent fingerprints and byte estimates covered only the primary transcript even when Claude Code and Cowork imports read additional subagent, audit, metadata, and artifact files, and changed bundles were not rejected after approval.
A permission or discovery failure in one adapter aborted the entire preview instead of reporting a safe source-specific unavailable status and recovery action.
Starting an approved session used a check-then-update without constraining the update by current status, so a concurrent cancellation could be overwritten back to running.
